name: create-ebook
description: Turn a book idea discussed in ChatGPT into a project on create-ebook, where the plan is edited, the chapters are written and the book is exported.

interface.longDescription: Turn an idea into a finished book. Tell ChatGPT what you want to write (a how-to guide, a workbook, a recipe book, a lead magnet, a course companion, a coloring book or a short novel) and create-ebook saves the idea, the format, the language and any outline you agreed on. A card shows the book and a button that opens it on create-ebook.com, where you sign in, check and edit the chapter plan, and the chapters are written one by one with a cover. Books are exported as PDF, EPUB and DOCX, with a print-ready paperback interior and cover for Amazon KDP. Works in English, French, Spanish and Portuguese. The app only receives the book idea and outline you share for this purpose, never your conversation; the writing itself happens on create-ebook.com.
capabilities: Prepare an ebook project from an idea
defaultPrompt: I want to write a how-to guide about starting a balcony vegetable garden.
Help me turn my yoga classes into a workbook for beginners.
I'd like to write a short cozy mystery set in a lighthouse.

positive.description: Start a how-to guide from a one-line idea
positive.prompt: I want to write a how-to guide about starting a balcony vegetable garden for complete beginners.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_ebook_plan with format guide and language en. The card shows the format, a working title, the idea and a 'Write this book' button. The button opens https://create-ebook.com/en/app/new with the idea and the guide format already filled in.

positive.prompt: Quiero hacer un libro de recetas italianas fáciles para cocinar entre semana.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_ebook_plan with format recipe_book and language es. The card is in Spanish ('Libro de recetas', 'Escribir este libro'). The link opens create-ebook in Spanish with the idea, the recipe book format and Spanish selected.

positive.prompt: I'd like to write a short cozy mystery novel set in a lighthouse on the Brittany coast.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_ebook_plan with format novel and language en, and shows the card with the novel format and a working title.

positive.description: Outline agreed in the chat is carried over
positive.prompt: Let's outline a workbook on saving money on groceries for young families: 6 chapters. When the outline is ready, prepare it on create-ebook.
positive.expected_behavior: After drafting the outline with the user, calls create_ebook_plan with format workbook and the chapter titles. The card lists the chapters, and the form on create-ebook contains the idea followed by the chapter list.

positive.prompt: Je veux créer un petit ebook gratuit pour ma liste e-mail, sur la gestion du temps pour les indépendants.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_ebook_plan with format lead_magnet and language fr. The card is in French ('Écrire ce livre') and the link opens the French app with the idea and the lead magnet format selected.

negative.description: Writing that is not a book project
negative.prompt: Write me a short poem about autumn.
Summarize this article about interest rates for me.
Publish my finished book on Amazon KDP for me with my account.

review.commerce_description: The app does not sell anything and processes no payment. It saves the book idea and returns a link to create-ebook.com.

publication.release_notes: First release: one tool, create_ebook_plan, that saves a book idea, format, language and optional outline, and shows a card that opens the project on create-ebook.com.

fr-FR.subtitle: Écrivez et publiez votre ebook
fr-FR.description: Transformez une idée en livre fini. Dites à ChatGPT ce que vous voulez écrire (guide pratique, cahier d’exercices, livre de recettes, lead magnet, support de formation, livre de coloriage ou court roman) et create-ebook enregistre l’idée, le format, la langue et le plan éventuel. Une carte présente le livre et un bouton l’ouvre sur create-ebook.com, où vous vous connectez, vérifiez et modifiez le plan, puis les chapitres s’écrivent un à un avec la couverture. Export PDF, EPUB et DOCX, avec intérieur et couverture prêts pour le broché Amazon KDP.

es-ES.subtitle: Escribe y publica tu ebook
es-ES.description: Convierte una idea en un libro terminado. Dile a ChatGPT qué quieres escribir (guía práctica, cuaderno de ejercicios, libro de recetas, lead magnet, material de curso, libro para colorear o novela corta) y create-ebook guarda la idea, el formato, el idioma y el esquema si lo hay. Una tarjeta muestra el libro y un botón lo abre en create-ebook.com, donde inicias sesión, revisas y editas el plan, y los capítulos se escriben uno a uno con la portada. Exporta a PDF, EPUB y DOCX, con interior y cubierta listos para la tapa blanda de Amazon KDP.

pt-BR.subtitle: Escreva e publique seu ebook
pt-BR.description: Transforme uma ideia num livro pronto. Diga ao ChatGPT o que você quer escrever (guia prático, caderno de exercícios, livro de receitas, isca digital, material de curso, livro de colorir ou romance curto) e o create-ebook guarda a ideia, o formato, o idioma e o roteiro, se houver. Um cartão mostra o livro e um botão o abre no create-ebook.com, onde você entra, revisa e edita o plano, e os capítulos são escritos um a um com a capa. Exporte em PDF, EPUB e DOCX, com miolo e capa prontos para a brochura da Amazon KDP.
